grok.performance_metric: Ch.11 ~9 mo; equity extinguished; ~$800M assets marketed ~3.3 yrs
grok.rationale: The slice documents Chapter 11 filing, extinguishment of the 2018 equity with no recovery, deregistration, later marketing of ~$800M of Permian/Haynesville assets, and a 2023 rebrand under an entirely new executive team, but contains no realized-outcome evidence that an acquired product line could not be aligned with operating processes over time (p4). It likewise does not document fracture at the process/organization interface—operations breaking against people, management, or culture—only ownership change, a new board at emergence, and subsequent leadership replacement without stated operational-integration failure (p5).
